name: Multiplayer
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Online multiplayer, first step: a Multiplayer page in the main menu's Options that connects to an OpenRAC server, creates a party or joins one by its code, and shows the lobby with your launcher name. Nothing of the game is played together yet.

settings.name: Server
settings.description: The OpenRAC server to connect to, as host:port (7770 when no port is given). Your name is the launcher's Multiplayer name (Settings).
